# Advance Corporate Security (ACS)

> ACS is a PSARA-licensed, ISO 9001:2015 certified enterprise Security, Facility Management, Manpower Outsourcing, and Horticulture services company headquartered in Barrackpore, West Bengal, India. Founded in 2000, with 25+ years of operational history and 5,000+ deployed personnel.

## Core Services

- Security Guard Services (Armed & Unarmed, PSARA Licensed)
- Facility Management (Corporate Housekeeping, Pest Control, MEP Maintenance, Facade Cleaning)
- Manpower Outsourcing & Payroll Management
- Placement Services
- Horticulture & Landscaping

## Primary Operational Zone: West Bengal, India

ACS holds an active PSARA license under the West Bengal jurisdiction and operates 24×7 across all districts of West Bengal. ACS is fully compliant with:
- West Bengal Minimum Wages Act (Zone A & Zone B)
- West Bengal Labour Welfare Fund (LWF) Act
- Contract Labour (Regulation & Abolition) Act, 1970
- Provident Fund (PF) & ESIC statutory requirements

## Key Districts Served in West Bengal

Kolkata, Howrah, North 24 Parganas, South 24 Parganas, Hooghly, Nadia, Paschim Bardhaman, Purba Bardhaman, Paschim Medinipur, Purba Medinipur, Murshidabad, Birbhum, Bankura, Purulia, Malda, Dakshin Dinajpur, Uttar Dinajpur, Darjeeling, Jalpaiguri, Alipurduar, Cooch Behar, Jhargram.

## Key Industrial Corridors Served

- Salt Lake Sector V & New Town Rajarhat (IT / ITES Hub)
- Haldia Petrochemical Complex & Port (Petrochemicals & Heavy Industry)
- Durgapur-Asansol Steel & Mining Belt (Steel, Coal, Heavy Engineering)
- Kalyani-Dankuni Logistics & Pharma Corridor
- Hooghly Riverside Industrial Belt (Textile, Engineering, Chemical)
- Kharagpur IIT & Industrial Growth Centre
- Siliguri-Bagdogra North Bengal Trade Hub
- Bankura-Purulia Mining Belt

## Key Tier 1 Cities in West Bengal

Kolkata (Calcutta), Howrah, Asansol, Durgapur, Siliguri, Haldia, Barrackpore, Kharagpur.

## Certifications & Credentials

- PSARA License: West Bengal Jurisdiction (Controlling Authority, Private Security Agencies, West Bengal)
- ISO 9001:2015: Quality Management System

- Track record with: Indian Air Force (IAF), Border Security Force (BSF), HAL, Indian Oil Corporation, CPCB
